purpose: Freeze the real DEV semantic-groundedness measurement transport, coverage requirements, single-attempt semantics, and aggregate gate before the independent judge reads the already-built E14n DEV semantic claim packet.

provider_transport.attempt_definition: one end-to-end run containing up to the six frozen provider requests
provider_transport.batching_unit: one provider request per fixed DEV call
provider_transport.provider_output_contract: reuse frozen synthetic case_id + claim_type + support_label contract
provider_transport.real_claim_to_provider_id_mapping: deterministic opaque case_id R#### within each fixed call

semantic_gate.pass_definition: all 69 claims receive valid labels; every factual_assertion is SUPPORTED; every non-factual claim type is NOT_APPLICABLE; therefore there are zero factual CONTRADICTED, factual NOT_SUPPORTED, factual NOT_APPLICABLE, or non-factual non-NOT_APPLICABLE rows

post_result_rules.if_operational_or_contract_failure: The real measurement attempt is consumed. Do not infer semantic quality from partial execution and do not rerun. A replacement procedure requires a new explicit preregistered amendment before any further real semantic measurement.
post_result_rules.if_semantic_gate_fails: Record aggregate failure and return to DEV candidate design without exposing or tuning from per-claim labels.
post_result_rules.if_semantic_gate_passes: Combine this semantic-groundedness result with frozen deterministic v4.1 metrics and remaining full-DEV prerequisites; VALIDATION remains blocked until all prerequisites independently pass.
